lines.text: The king will exalt himself above every god and honor a god of fortresses that his fathers did not know.
The king of the North will storm out with chariots, horsemen, and many ships, and Edom, Moab, and the leaders of the Ammonites will be delivered.
The invader will gain control of the treasures of Egypt, and the Libyans and Assyrians will submit to him.
Gabriel, the great prince, will rise up, and many who sleep in the dust will awake, some to everlasting life.
The man dressed in linen swears by Him who lives forever that it will be for a time, times, and half a time.
